en.title: The third launch date for the Hope Probe, per the latest update from the UAE Space Agency
en.excerpt: The Regional Centre, AUASS and partners invite you to the live broadcast of the Hope Probe launch on its third scheduled date, 20 July 2020, with speeches and scientific commentary.
en.body:
The Regional Centre for Space Science and Technology Education for Western Asia, the Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences and partners
are pleased to invite you to the live broadcast
of the launch of the Emirati probe to explore the Red Planet,
the Hope Probe
The Hope Probe

Opening of the session, moderated by Dr. Awni Khasawneh, Director General of the Regional Centre for Space Science and Technology Education for Western Asia

Speech by Prof. Hamid Al-Naimiy, President of the Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences and Chancellor of the University of Sharjah
Speech by Dr. Mohammed Al Ahbabi, Director General of the UAE Space Agency / Japan

Scientific commentary, moderated by Dr. Ammar Sakaji, Vice President of the Jordanian Astronomical Society

Dr. Ahmad Bani Younes, professor of aerospace engineering and executive director of the space laboratory at San Diego State University, USA
Dr. Ayman Qadoumi, aerospace engineering researcher, formerly with NASA
Dr. Hanna Sabbat, Deputy Director of the Centre for Theoretical Physics and Astrophysics
